candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition with true so that anyone can call withdrawAll, changing the observable restriction on who succeeds.
Replace the require condition with false so that withdrawAll always reverts, observable as a change from possible success to permanent failure.
Change the recipient of the transfer to msg.sender, which alters who receives the contract balance and is observable through balance checks.
Change the transfer amount to 1 wei instead of the full contract balance, observable as a different transferred amount.
Delete the require statement so that anyone can call withdrawAll and succeed, observable by non-owners being able to drain the contract.
Delete the transfer statement so that the contract never sends its balance, observable by balance not changing after a presumably successful call.
